review_notes: s005bss: the complete static set of seg005 (290 B _BSS at [200042,200332)) is 27 static objects: replay_control (file scope, before replay_unk2), 17 block-scope statics of setup_car_shapes (its former K&R block externs become statics in the same block) and 9 file-scope statics before loop_game. The code bytes outside FIXUPP fields, fixup locations/kinds and relocations are identical to the canonical extern form; only the 198 _BSS FIXUPP targets change.

MSC 5.10 emits each object's statics in _BSS as it reaches each function definition: pending file-scope statics first, ordered by bucket sum(b&0xDF) mod 256 ascending, then that function's block-scope statics ordered by bucket sum(b) & 15 ascending (the local-slot rule); ties go newest declaration first. The fixture build/workers/s005bss/e1..e4.c and the canonical control ctl.c confirm this. Consequently last_tacho, last_speedo, stdares, stdbres, meters_sprite, wheel_shapes, gnob_sprite, gear_base_sprite, steering_zone, steering_dot_x/y, gear_knob_visible_view, last_steering_step, replayshapes, camera_buttons_pressed, camera_mode_view and camera_buttons_state_per_view are compiler-hash-constrained reconstruction names (readable, semantic, never recovered originals), and the setup_car_shapes block declaration order is chosen for the bucket ties.
